actions.description: Batch create, update, or delete Algolia objects.
actions.name: batch-objects

indexName.description: Name of the Algolia index. Example: "algolia_movie_sample_dataset"

requests.description: Batch operations to perform on the index.

actions.description: Copy an Algolia index to a new destination index.
actions.name: copy-index

sourceIndexName.description: Name of the source index to copy. Example: "algolia_movie_sample_dataset"

destinationIndexName.description: Name of the destination index. Example: "nango_test_copy_index_destination"

scope.description: Optional array of scopes to copy. If omitted, the entire index is copied.

taskID.description: The Algolia task ID for the copy operation

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the operation was performed

actions.description: Create an API key in Algolia.
actions.name: create-api-key

acl.description: Permissions that determine the type of API requests this key can make. Example: ["search", "addObject"]

description.description: Description of an API key to help you identify this API key. Example: "Used for indexing by the CLI"

indexes.description: Index names or patterns that this API key can access. Example: ["dev_*", "prod_en_products"]

maxHitsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of results this API key can retrieve in one query.

maxQueriesPerIPPerHour.description: Maximum number of API requests allowed per IP address or user token per hour.

queryParameters.description: Query parameters to add when making API requests with this API key. Example: "typoTolerance=strict&restrictSources=192.168.1.0/24"

referers.description: Allowed HTTP referrers for this API key. Example: ["*algolia.com*"]

validity.description: Duration (in seconds) after which the API key expires. Example: 86400

key.description: The newly created API key. Example: 13ad45b4d0a2f6ea65ecbddf6aa260f2

createdAt.description: Date and time when the API key was created, in RFC 3339 format. Example: 2023-07-04T12:49:15Z

actions.description: Create an object in an Algolia index. Returns a generated objectID.
actions.name: create-object

indexName.description: Name of the Algolia index. Example: "algolia_movie_sample_dataset"

object.description: The record to add. A schemaless object with attributes that are useful in the context of search and discovery.

objectID.description: Optional object ID. If provided, the record is added or replaced at this ID instead of auto-generating one.

actions.description: Create a query rule in an Algolia index.
actions.name: create-rule

indexName.description: Name of the Algolia index. Example: "algolia_movie_sample_dataset"

objectID.description: Unique identifier for the rule. Example: "nango-test-rule-create"

pattern.description: Query pattern that triggers the rule. Example: "smartphone"

anchoring.description: Which part of the search query the pattern should match. Example: "contains"

alternatives.description: Whether the pattern should match plurals, synonyms, and typos.

context.description: An additional restriction that only triggers the rule when the search has the same ruleContexts value.

filters.description: Filters that trigger the rule. Example: "genre:comedy"

params.description: Parameters to apply to this search.

promote.description: Records to pin to a specific position in the search results.

filterPromotes.description: Whether promoted records must also match active filters.

hide.description: Records to hide from the search results.

redirect.description: Redirect to a virtual replica index.

userData.description: Custom data appended to the userData array in the response.

validity.description: Time periods when the rule is active.

from.description: Timestamp when the rule should start to be active, measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

until.description: Timestamp when the rule should stop to be active, measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

indexName.description: Algolia index name. Example: "algolia_movie_sample_dataset"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Rename an Algolia index by moving it to a new name (destructive — overwrites destination).
actions.name: move-index

indexName.description: Name of the source index to move. Example: "my-source-index"

destinationIndexName.description: Name of the destination index. The source index is renamed to this name, overwriting any existing index with the same name. Example: "my-destination-index"

taskID.description: Algolia task ID for tracking the asynchronous operation.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the move operation was submitted.

actions.description: Update specific attributes of an existing Algolia object without replacing the whole record.
actions.name: partial-update-object

indexName.description: Name of the Algolia index containing the object. Example: "algolia_movie_sample_dataset"

objectID.description: ID of the object to partially update. Example: "nango-test-obj-get"

attributes.description: Attributes to update on the object. Only first-level attributes are supported.

actions.description: Run an Algolia search query against an index.

indexName.description: Name of the index to search. Example: "algolia_movie_sample_dataset"

hitsPerPage.description: Number of hits per page. Example: 20

attributesToRetrieve.description: Attributes to include in the response. Example: ["title","year"]

facets.description: Facets for which to retrieve counts. Example: ["genre"]

actions.description: Run search queries across multiple Algolia indices in a single request.
actions.name: search-multiple-indices

indexName.description: Name of the index to search. Example: "algolia_movie_sample_dataset"

requests.description: Array of search requests, one per index or query. Maximum 50 requests.

results.description: Search results in the same order as the requests.
